description: Loads a semantic modeling source and presents a modeling editor workspace. On the docked layouts (tablet/desktop, resolved from the editor's own container) the workspace renders through the core TmEditorShell: Header (title, state badge, the provider/notation/viewpoint group), Left (model tree), Canvas (diagram preview with the collapsible Issues dock under it — header with a neutral count, aria-expanded toggle, the collapsed state is session-owned), Right (inspector with Properties | Source tabs — only the active tab renders its body, a stale source marks the Source tab with a neutral indicator and the tab drives the editor's reload) and StatusBar. Below the editor's own mobile threshold the pre-redesign compact workspace (panel tabs, one visible panel) renders until the mobile phase. The preview's "Open in editor" action opens the generated document in a core TmModal viewport dialog (scrim, TmFocusScope focus trap, Escape) sized ~90vw x 90vh on the desktop; the dialog header owns the document title (falling back to the "Open in editor" label) and the close button, and the embedded TmDiagramEditor keeps every panel with ToolbarPreset=Full and ShowTitle=false (one header). Changes keep propagating live to the preview (G8), so the scrim is not a close affordance.

parameters.name: ProviderKey
parameters.description: Provider key used to select the semantic model provider. Null or empty values render the empty state.

parameters.name: ProviderKeyChanged
parameters.description: Raised when the user picks a provider in the header selector; enables @bind-ProviderKey. The editor reloads the model with the selected provider.

parameters.name: ShowProviderSelector
parameters.description: Renders a labeled "Provider" select in the editor header that lists every registered IModelingModelProvider (MO3). Default false keeps the pre-selector behavior: the provider stays a labeled value chip and remains host-owned through ProviderKey.

parameters.name: AllowNodeDrop
parameters.description: Whether model tree elements can be reused by dropping them onto the preview canvas.

parameters.name: Class
parameters.description: Additional CSS class applied to the editor root.

parameters.name: ModelLoaderOverride
parameters.description: Optional loader used by host pages or tests to supply a model without registering a provider.

parameters.name: ProviderDisplayName
parameters.description: Optional display-name resolver for the provider options and the provider chip (review fix, phase 3). Receives the raw provider key and returns the text to show; when the callback is null (or returns nothing) the raw key itself is shown. The demo maps the keys to localized names; a host may resolve them from its own registry.

parameters.name: NotationKey
parameters.description: Optional notation key passed to the selected provider and generator.

parameters.name: OnDiagramGenerated
parameters.description: Callback raised after a model is loaded and converted into a diagram document.

parameters.name: OnNodeDropped
parameters.description: Callback raised after a model tree element is reused as a new preview node.

parameters.name: OnNotationChanged
parameters.description: Callback raised when the editor notation selection changes.

parameters.name: OnOpenInEditor
parameters.description: Callback raised when the user opens the generated diagram in the full diagram editor.

parameters.name: OnProviderChanged
parameters.description: Raised when the editor provider selection changes (semantics of OnNotationChanged for the provider).

parameters.name: OnViewpointChanged
parameters.description: Callback raised when the editor viewpoint selection changes.

parameters.name: ViewpointKey
parameters.description: Optional viewpoint key passed to the selected provider and used to choose the initial model view.

parameters.name: LayoutMode
parameters.description: How the editor resolves its presentation. Auto (default) measures the editor's own container with the shared observer (mobile below 768px of container, tablet 768-899, desktop from 900 — the docked shell needs tree + inspector + the canvas minimum at once); a forced mode renders that layout without any measurement so tests and hosts can pin it. The docked layouts render through the core TmEditorShell; the compact layout keeps the panel-tab workspace.

parameters.name: InitialMode
parameters.description: The mode rendered before the first measurement of an Auto editor (SSR, prerender and the first frame). Desktop markup degrades acceptably through the data-layout CSS.

parameters.name: LayoutBreakpoints
parameters.description: Per-instance thresholds for the editor's own container. Null keeps the Modeling pair (mobile below 768px of container, tablet 768-899, desktop from 900). Only the markup branch moves; stylesheets keep the shared literals.

parameters.name: Height
parameters.description: The editor's block size (any CSS height). Null keeps the stylesheet contract min(768px, 100vh - 32px) (the token pair on .tm-modeling-editor). When set, the editor renders exactly this height (the token min-height floor is dropped with an inline min-height: 0) and the shell inside fills the box.

cssClasses.name: tm-modeling-editor__state
cssClasses.description: Wrapper around the state TmBadge next to the editor title (variant by state).

cssClasses.name: tm-modeling-editor__status-item
cssClasses.description: One separated status item; the first carries the state icon (and the last-loaded time when the model carries metadata, MO3).

cssClasses.name: tm-modeling-editor__status-icon
cssClasses.description: Leading status icon (check/alert/clock by state), aria-hidden.

cssClasses.name: tm-modeling-editor__context
cssClasses.description: Right-aligned header group wrapping the provider field/chip and the TmModelingViewSelector; wraps as a whole under the title and becomes a single-column grid below 48rem (review fix, phase 3).

cssClasses.name: tm-modeling-editor__field
cssClasses.description: Labeled header field (label above the select) hosting the provider selector when ShowProviderSelector is on; may shrink to its token minimum inside the wrapping context group (review fix, phase 3).

cssClasses.name: tm-modeling-editor__open-editor-modal
cssClasses.description: Class on the open-editor TmModal overlay root; sizes the modal panel to ~90vw x 90vh on the desktop and to a near-fullscreen panel below 48rem.

cssClasses.name: tm-modeling-editor__open-editor-body
cssClasses.description: Dialog body wrapper filling the TmModal body; hosts the embedded diagram editor.

cssClasses.name: tm-modeling-editor__open-editor-diagram
cssClasses.description: The embedded TmDiagramEditor inside the dialog body; fills the body height.

cssClasses.name: tm-modeling-editor__shell
cssClasses.description: Class applied to the core TmEditorShell root on the docked layouts; fills the editor box and neutralizes the shell's generic header/status/canvas padding so the modeling chrome owns its own rhythm.

cssClasses.name: tm-modeling-editor__canvas-body
cssClasses.description: The docked canvas surface: a grid with the preview row (minmax(0,1fr)) and the issues dock row (auto). Also the focusWithin surface containing the open-editor trigger and dialog.

cssClasses.name: tm-modeling-editor__canvas-body--issues-open
cssClasses.description: Modifier rendered while the Issues dock is expanded; the dock row becomes a token clamp (min 12rem, preferred 38%, cap 20rem of the canvas region) so the list scrolls inside the dock and the preview keeps its row.

cssClasses.name: tm-modeling-editor__inspector
cssClasses.description: The inspector wrapper inside the shell's right dock; carries the frozen modeling-inspector-panel test id and the Properties | Source TmTabs (sticky tab strip).
